name: Bali
blurb: Bali remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Good value compared with last year
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Some report crowding at peak times
Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
